page_title: MAL 0-3 BAR | Mallorca v Barcelona 16/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' 0 - 3 Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a precise pass inside the box from Gavi and he beats the goalkeeper with a brilliant shot into the top left corner. 0:3.
90+2' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Mallorca will take a free kick.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Johan Mojica departs the field of play to be replaced by Toni Lato (Mallorca).
90+1' Jose Munuera blows for a foul after Gavi (Barcelona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Mallorca get a free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

90' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
89' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

88' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Leo Roman easily makes the save. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
85' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Dani Olmo (Barcelona) takes it short.

85' Pedri (Barcelona) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Leo Roman sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. The referee blows his whistle, Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
83' The referee signals a substitution. Jan Salas (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Sergi Darder.
82' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Munuera blows for a foul. Mallorca are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
81' Jofre Torrents (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
81' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Dani Olmo (Barcelona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is coming onto the pitch as Raphinha cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' A cooling break is underway.
75' Dangerous play by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona). Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

74' The cross into the penalty area from Jofre Torrents (Barcelona) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

72' Raphinha (Barcelona) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.

71' What a save from Leo Roman! Eric Garcia (Barcelona) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
70' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
69' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ferran Torres walks off the pitch to be replaced by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona).
69' Here is a change. Pau Cubarsi is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Gavi (Barcelona).
68' Substitution. Jofre Torrents (Barcelona) in, Alejandro Balde out.
68' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
67' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but Joan Garcia punches the ball away.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.
66' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Mallorca.
65' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Munuera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick to Mallorca.
64' Raphinha (Barcelona) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
64' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
63' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
62' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
62' The game is interrupted now, Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
61' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Munuera interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Mallorca have been awarded a free kick.

59' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Raphinha (Barcelona), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

59' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and attempts to place his header under the crossbar. Leo Roman shows his fast reflexes, though, and makes a nice save.
58' Half-chance! Eric Garcia (Barcelona) plays a pass into the box, but Leo Roman reacts well to snuff out the attack.
56' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Mallorca.
55' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) commits a foul and Jose Munuera immediately signals a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Mallorca.
54' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
53' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
53' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) is able to continue to play.
52' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
51' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Leo Roman intercepts the ball.
51' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) takes a short corner kick.

50' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Now Barcelona have a corner.
49' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

48' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
47' The linesman signals that Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
46' Half-time substitution. Takuma Asano will not participate anymore and Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) is coming on.
46' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) comes on the pitch for Mateu Morey Bauza.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Jagoba Arrasate probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Pablo Torre. He is replaced by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca).
46' Hansi Flick makes a switch. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is coming on in place of Fermin Lopez at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Raphinha (Barcelona) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jose Munuera ignores the protests.

45+6' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the left post. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

45+5' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) blows a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounced on a rebound but headed it just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
45+5' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
45+3' Jose Munuera couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) and blew his whistle. Mallorca have a free kick.
45+2' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

45+2' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), but referee Jose Munuera must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
45+1' Half-chance! Takuma Asano (Mallorca) plays a pass into the box, but Joan Garcia reacts well to snuff out the attack.
45' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
45' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is caught offside!
44' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
42' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) sees a yellow card from Jose Munuera after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
41' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) makes a strong challenge and Jose Munuera blows for a foul. Mallorca are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
41' Joan Garcia (Barcelona) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
40' The game is interrupted as Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is flagged offside.
39' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) has to leave the pitch!
37' Joan Garcia (Barcelona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

35' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
33' Jose Munuera blows his whistle and Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
32' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. It's a free kick to Barcelona in a dangerous position.
28' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
28' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for an infringement. Mallorca earn a free kick.
26' One of the players from Mallorca times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
26' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Joan Garcia, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.
25' Jagoba Arrasate isn't happy on the touchline after referee Jose Munuera shows him a yellow card.
24' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) uses the wrong choice of words while trying to explain something to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
23' 0 - 2 Goal! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top left corner. 0:2.
23' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
21' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Joan Garcia is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
21' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner.
19' The referee blows his whistle as Johan Mojica (Mallorca) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

18' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Munuera blows for a foul. Free kick. Mallorca will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
18' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
16' Raphinha (Barcelona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

14' The game is interrupted. Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Mallorca, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
14' Raphinha (Barcelona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
12' Jose Munuera blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ferran Torres (Barcelona) brought his opponent down. Mallorca have a free kick.
12' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
11' Rough tackle by Ronald Araujo (Barcelona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Mallorca.
9' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jose Munuera didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
9' Referee Jose Munuera points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Barcelona players.
9' Celebrations by Barcelona are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
7' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Lamine Yamal sends a long raking pass onto the head of Raphinha (Barcelona), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
6' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is adjudged offside.

3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
2' Barcelona are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has started.
Mallorca will kick-off.
Jose Munuera is the one to supervise the game today.
